name: Hydraulic Modelling Laboratory
description: Mathematical hydraulic modelling of 1D river flow under steady and unsteady conditions, coupled 1D-2D unsteady flow in rivers and floodplains, modeling hydraulic structures and dam break analysis using HEC-RAS, 3D CFD modelling of rapidly varied and spatially varied open channel flow using the VOF method, 3D VOF-DPM coupled CFD modelling for sediment transport in open channel flow, 3D CFD-based Eulerian modelling of industrial slurry pipeline flow using Ansys FLUENT software, physical hydraulic modelling of hydraulic jump and slurry pipeline flow.
